scope: Ten bounded repairs from R0, R1 and the first four R2 findings. This is not closure of all 39 findings or product acceptance.
cross_cutting_reason: Recovery, private ownership and financial provenance require coordinated route, service, contract, UI, test and documentation changes; the batch necessarily exceeds ten files.

sets.behavior: Split the configured file list into ordered arguments, preserve spaces, reject missing/empty paths, validate configuration and require the installed database's exact ordered configuration label before backup/restore work.
sets.limit: Fake-command tests do not certify a normal-installation backup or restore. No backup helper was run against normal data.

sets.behavior: Before crossing 2167b87f7054, inspect the seven affected tables and reject populated predecessors. PostgreSQL table locks remain held through the migration transaction. Offline crossing is refused. Historical migrations are unchanged.
sets.limit: No preserving conversion of populated legacy rows or populated restore was implemented or attempted. No affected normal database or backup was established.

sets.outcome: Protect private thesis evidence from shared-event deletion
sets.behavior: Lock the event and reject deletion when any retained thesis impact depends on it, without revealing private owners or reasoning. Safe unreferenced deletion remains supported.

sets.outcome: Preserve source-defining fields and dependent documents
sets.behavior: Block source-body, identity, payload, date, URL and hash changes through the raw-document update API; allow display-title changes and unchanged fields. Reject deletion when any persisted foreign-key consumer retains evidence.
sets.limit: Corrected evidence must be imported separately. This is an application API boundary, not a database-wide immutability guarantee or historical repair.

sets.behavior: Use a correlated existence check for the caller's nonzero holdings. Foreign holdings, zero positions and duplicate holdings cannot alter or duplicate the filtered alert list.

sets.outcome: Separate public processing coverage from private attempts
sets.behavior: One visibility policy excludes private attempts from public brief/dashboard counts and selections. Processing history includes public runs and the caller's recorded private runs. New private producers and refresh children retain owner context.
sets.limit: Legacy private attempts without recorded owners remain hidden. No owner was guessed or historic brief regenerated.

sets.outcome: Retain manual override origin through review and promotion
sets.behavior: Keep the first extracted value/unit and a dated user edit history. Undo, Accept and promotion retain User Assumption classification in the candidate, revision contract and UI. Evidence pages call the result an assumed value.
evidence: isolated in-app browser override, Undo, Accept, period confirmation and promotion
sets.limit: An original already lost in legacy data is marked unknown when detectable; already-promoted lost history is not reconstructed.

sets.outcome: Retain PDF column period context and hold ambiguous duration
sets.behavior: Parser v7 retains header text and column context. Quarterly/YTD and unresolved month durations cannot inherit annual scope from the document category. Mixed unmapped headers remain unknown. End-date confirmation cannot override missing or contradictory annual duration evidence.
sets.limit: This remains a bounded parser, not arbitrary merged-header reconstruction. Legacy synthetic FY labels may require re-extraction. No stored candidates were rewritten.

sets.behavior: Store validated workbook bytes in DocumentAsset, serve the correct attachment MIME type and reject PDF rendering. Exact-company, exact-hash re-upload can restore a missing old asset without re-extraction or candidate changes. Source pages expose the original or an explicit missing-original notice, and exclude incompatible parsing controls.
evidence: isolated in-app browser workbook source page
sets.limit: An absent original requires the identical source file. Browser download-event completion timed out; backend byte/hash/MIME preservation is verified, browser download completion is not.

sets.outcome: Use original SEC fact filing dates in dated evidence
sets.behavior: Project fact-level filed dates only for matching SEC extraction/snapshot identities. Different facts in one snapshot retain different dates. Invalid, missing or inconsistent filing dates remain unknown; retrieval and recording remain separate.
sets.limit: No document publication date was overwritten. This is not full historical source-vintage reconstruction.
